description_sq:
Shitet Super Apartament ne Farke. Pjese e nje kompleksi Rezidencial me Vila dhe Apartamente.
Godinat jane 2 katshe, vetem 4 apartamente ne total.
Apartamenti pozicionohet ne kat te dyte.
Siperfaqe totale 84.6 m2
Parkim ne perdorim.
Kompleksi ne ndertim, mbaron per nje vit.
Mundesi financimi deri ne 70%, kolaterali mundesohet nga firma e ndertimit)
description_en: Super apartment for sale in Farke. Part of a residential complex with villas and apartments. The buildings are 2 floors, only 4 apartments in total. The apartment is located on the second floor. Total area 84.6 m2 Parking in use. The complex is under construction, it will be finished in one year. Possibility of financing up to 70%, the collateral is provided by the construction company)
